items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Clear names (buildWindowSpec, validateWindowName, windowSql, windowChunks). Dialect edits match the surrounding sql`` template style. The summary says public helpers are documented, and the tests are well organised by describe blocks.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One shared buildWindowSpec, but the same WINDOW-clause loop is pasted into all 5 dialects. .window() is also duplicated on *SelectBuilder (before from) as well as the QueryBuilderBase. window.ts sits in sql/expressions, not sql/functions as the project convention asks.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Inputs are validated where they enter: window names (non-empty, whitespace), frame from/to order, preceding/following ints, ntile/nthValue positives. Tests check rows({} as any) throws. Hidden tests pass 130/130. Nothing is caught or swallowed silently.

items.name: Public API additions are additive and consistent across dialects
items.name_zh: 公共 API 新增保持向后兼容且各方言一致
items.evidence: Additive and available on all 5 dialects, with an optional windows?: field. But exports come from sql/expressions/window.ts, not sql/functions. Constructors now always set windows: [] in config, and an extra .window() was added on the pre-from SelectBuilder, so the API surface differs from the spec.
